_readme: Add your own PDFs/DOCX to this folder and list them under "books". Each entry needs at least: file (path relative to the site root) and title. Then commit and push - the book appears on every device you open the site from.

books.title: Your 180-day study handbook
books.desc: Complete daily plan, weekly targets and study routines. Printable PDF.
books.subject: Plan

books.title: Your 180-day handbook · Word
books.desc: Editable DOCX version. Read here or download for personal planning.
books.subject: Plan

books.title: Complete study notes · offline collection
books.desc: All 142 topic notes in one reference. The fastest way to revise away from the app.
books.subject: All subjects

books.title: Open Data Structures · Java
books.author: Pat Morin
books.subject: Data Structures
books.desc: Full textbook: arrays, lists, hashing, trees, heaps and graphs. Begin with chapters 1-3, 5-6 and 10.

books.title: Think Python · Second edition
books.author: Allen B. Downey
books.subject: Programming
books.desc: Python foundations, functions, collections and objects. A full introductory book for daily reading.
books.license: CC BY-NC 3.0 · unmodified · noncommercial study use

books.title: Algorithms
books.author: Jeff Erickson
books.subject: Algorithms
books.desc: Deep practice in recursion, backtracking, greedy algorithms and dynamic programming.

books.title: Computer Networks: A Systems Approach
books.author: Larry Peterson & Bruce Davie
books.subject: Computer Networks
books.desc: Full university textbook. Read chapters 1-2 (foundation, links), 3 (switching), 4 (internetworking), 5 (transport) and 8 (security).

books.title: Database Design · Second edition
books.author: Adrienne Watt & Nelson Eng
books.subject: DBMS
books.desc: Open textbook covering the relational model, ER modelling, normalisation and SQL basics.
books.license: CC BY 4.0 · BCcampus Open Education · unmodified

books.title: The Little Book of Semaphores
books.author: Allen B. Downey
books.subject: Operating Systems
books.desc: Process synchronisation in depth — producer-consumer, readers-writers, dining philosophers, and every classic problem with worked solutions.
books.license: CC BY-NC · unmodified · noncommercial study use

books.title: Crypto 101
books.author: Laurens Van Houtven
books.subject: Cyber Security
books.desc: Introductory cryptography: block ciphers, modes, hashes, MACs, signatures and how they fail. Pairs with the cryptography notes.

books.title: NIST SP 800-207 · Zero Trust Architecture
books.author: NIST
books.subject: Cyber Security
books.desc: The definitive zero-trust reference. Read the tenets in section 2 — quotable in the descriptive paper and the interview.

books.title: NIST SP 800-61r3 · Incident Response
books.author: NIST
books.subject: Cyber Security
books.desc: Incident handling lifecycle. Maps directly onto SEBI CSCRF respond-and-recover expectations.

books.title: NIST SP 800-145 · The NIST Definition of Cloud Computing
books.author: NIST
books.subject: Cloud
books.desc: Three pages. The five essential characteristics and the service/deployment models every cloud question is built on.

books.title: Eloquent JavaScript, 4th edition
books.author: Marijn Haverbeke
books.subject: Web Technologies
books.desc: JavaScript, the DOM, HTTP and asynchronous programming. Chapters 13-18 cover the browser and web platform the IT paper asks about.
books.license: CC BY-NC 3.0 · unmodified · noncommercial study use

books.title: Digital Circuit Projects
books.author: Charles W. Kann
books.subject: Computer Organisation
books.desc: Logic gates, Boolean algebra, combinational and sequential circuits, counters and registers - the digital-logic half of the COA syllabus.

books.title: forall x: Calgary — An Introduction to Formal Logic
books.author: Magnus, Button, Loftis, Trueman, Zach
books.subject: Reasoning
books.desc: Formal logic underneath syllogisms, validity and deduction. Read chapters 1-3 for the reasoning that statement-and-conclusion questions test.

books.title: The Scrum Guide (2020)
books.author: Ken Schwaber & Jeff Sutherland
books.subject: Software Engineering
books.desc: Thirteen pages, and the definitive source on Scrum roles, events and artefacts. Read it once; it answers every Agile question directly.

books.title: The Elements of Style
books.author: William Strunk Jr.
books.subject: English (Descriptive)
books.desc: Short, public-domain style guide. One read improves the Phase II descriptive paper more than any grammar drill.
